title: How I AI: Claude Duet honest review + Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny’s Podcast Network
summary: In this episode, he shows how the system combines real Reddit data, reusable scaffolds, Cursor annotations, and a custom design system MCP to turn ideas into shareable prototypes. He also explains how Reddit’s teams have built about 700 prototypes, reached 100% adoption across UX and product, and developed a Figma-to-PRD workflow that makes engineering handoffs far more precise.
takeaways: Blair’s team mapped Reddit’s tokens, components, and workflows directly to production code.

Listen now on YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts In this solo episode, Claire tests Claude Duet, Anthropic’s beautifully designed new personal agent, to see whether it deserves a place in her increasingly crowded AI stack.
Biggest takeaways: Claude Duet is the most polished personal agent launch yet.
